_comment: === J&J NAIL SPA – SITE CONFIGURATION ===  Edit this file to update ALL text, images, and info shown on the website.  You do NOT need to touch any code files — just change values here and the site updates automatically.

about._comment: The 'About Us' section — tells visitors what makes your salon special
about.title: Your Destination for
paragraphs: Welcome to J&J Nail Spa — a brand new, state-of-the-art nail salon designed with your comfort and beauty in mind. Our spacious, modern interior features luxurious spa chairs, marble floors, and a warm, inviting atmosphere.

Our team of highly skilled technicians brings years of experience and a passion for nail artistry to every appointment. We use only top-quality, safe products to ensure beautiful, long-lasting results.

services._comment: The 6 service cards — each shows an image, name, short description, and starting price
services.title: Complete Nail Care
services.subtitle: From classic manicures to creative nail art — we offer a full range of services using premium products for lasting results.

items.name: Gel Manicure
items.description: Long-lasting gel polish, chip-free for 3-4 weeks with a beautiful, glossy finish.

items.name: Pedicure & Spa
items.description: Relaxing foot soak, exfoliation, hot stone massage, and your choice of polish.

items.name: Nail Art & Design
items.description: Custom hand-painted designs, trendy styles from Korea & Japan, personalized for you.

items.name: Acrylic & Dip Powder
items.description: Strong, durable nail extensions with natural-looking results and custom shaping.

items.name: Waxing Services
items.description: Gentle, effective waxing for smooth skin — eyebrow, lip, arm, leg, and full body.

items.name: Eyelash Extensions
items.description: Natural or dramatic lash extensions, customized to your eye shape and style.

reviews._comment: Customer testimonials — shown on a dark background. Add real Google reviews here.
reviews.title: What Our
reviews.subtitle: Real reviews from real clients — your satisfaction is our greatest reward.

items.text: I honestly didn't expect to be taken care of this well because the salon was pretty busy when I came in, but everyone was still so kind, patient, and attentive. I never felt like I was being rushed at all. They really took their time with my nails and made sure I was happy with the shape and design before finishing. I absolutely love how soft, clean, and elegant they turned out. I really appreciate how welcoming and helpful the team was even during a busy time. Thank you so much for the beautiful nails and such a great experience. I'll definitely be coming back!
items.name: Karim Niylah

items.text: The service was wonderful. Clean and staff so friendly. My nail technician was so attentive to do a great job. I was impressed and would highly recommend their service.
items.name: Susan Whittington

items.text: Such a great relaxing experience. This will be my new go to place for getting my nails done. Great Pedicure and Manicure
items.name: Elaina Downs

items.title: Customer Appreciation
items.description: Thank you for your continued support! Enjoy 10% off your service as a token of our appreciation.

items.title: Gift Cards
items.description: The perfect gift for any occasion. Available in-store in any denomination.

items.title: Quality Guarantee
items.description: We stand behind our work. Your satisfaction is our top priority. Contact us for any fixes within our warranty period.

policies._comment: Salon policies and etiquette for the Policies page
policies.title: Salon Policies
policies.subtitle: Please review our guidelines to ensure a relaxing experience for everyone.

items.title: Service Guarantee
items.content: We take pride in our work. If you experience any issues with your nails (like chipping or lifting) within a reasonable timeframe, please contact us for a complimentary fix.

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content: We require at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations may be subject to a fee.

items.title: Late Arrival
items.content: If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may need to reschedule your appointment or shorten your service time to accommodate other clients.

items.title: Walk-Ins
items.content: Walk-ins are always welcome, but appointments are highly recommended to guarantee your preferred time and technician.

items.title: Payment & Gratuity
items.content: We accept Cash, Visa, Mastercard, and Discover. Gratuities are greatly appreciated and can be left in cash or added to your card.

items.title: Kids & Guests
items.content: For the safety of children and the relaxation of our guests, we ask that children only accompany you if they are receiving a service.

items.title: Accessibility
items.content: Our salon is fully wheelchair accessible. Please let us know if you require any special accommodations when booking.
